# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

Seed iteration. Diagnosed all 5 failing val tasks (11,17,22,23,40) from `./trajectories/`,
cross-referenced each with its gold actions + reward_breakdown (from tau2 tasks.json).

## Ranked issue list (clusters by leverage, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Baggage free-allowance miscomputed → wrong nonfree + $50 overcharge → DB mismatch | 17, (22) | Agent uses wrong free-bag allowance (treats gold/economy as 2 free, should be 3); sets nonfree=1 and adds a $50 payment gold doesn't have | BEHAVIORAL / RULE-VIOLATION | in-body computation override in `update_reservation_baggages` |
| 2 | Exact refund/charge not communicated | 11, (23) | Agent reports its own pre-confirmation ESTIMATE ($1,515) instead of the tool-computed amount ($5244); communicate check fails | KNOWLEDGE + return-enrichment | new `payment_change_summary` on money-moving tools + policy MANDATORY rule + worked example |
| 3 | Wrong reservation picked + demanded already-known DOB → transfer | 22 | Guessed reservation id instead of matching route (NY→Chicago = EWR→ORD); demanded DOB already on file for the account holder | BEHAVIORAL / reasoning | additive policy procedure (identify by route; reuse known DOB) |
| 4 | Action stall after "yes" | 40 | Confirmed, user replied "Yes.###STOP###", agent never executed the write | BEHAVIORAL | additive policy rule "act immediately after yes" |
| 5 | basic-economy → cheapest business (cancel+rebook×3, split payment) | 23 | Multi-step: wrong return-leg flight selection + payment split; needs DB AND COMMUNICATE | CAPABILITY (complex reasoning) | deprioritized — only the communicate lever partially applies |

## Changes made this iteration
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | in-body computation | tools.py `update_reservation_baggages` + `_correct_nonfree_baggages`/`_free_bags_per_passenger` | Recompute nonfree = max(0, total − free_per_pax(membership,cabin)×passengers) from the policy table; ignore a wrong passed value. General for any membership/cabin/pax. | Yes — only passing caller is 12 (gold/economy/2pax, total 2 → nonfree 0 unchanged) |
| 2 | enriched return + tool docs | tools.py `book_reservation`, `update_reservation_flights`, `update_reservation_baggages` + `_change_summary`/`_reservation_with_summary` | Add top-level `payment_change_summary` string with the exact charge/refund; keep all reservation fields (superset shape). | Yes — DB unchanged; communicate checks only require info PRESENCE; extra info neutral |
| 2 | missing-rule + worked example | policy.md new "Reporting the exact amount…" section | MANDATORY: quote `payment_change_summary` verbatim; never report own estimate; refund example ($5244 vs wrong $1,515). | Additive knowledge |
| 3 | additive procedure | policy.md "Modify flight" | Locate reservation by route via get_user_details→get_reservation_details on each id; map city→IATA; reuse on-file DOB; don't transfer over it. | Additive |
| 4 | additive rule | policy.md confirmation paragraph | Act in the same turn once the user says yes. | Additive |
| — | knowledge + doc | policy.md baggage section; baggages docstring | Explicit free-bag formula + worked example; docstring notes nonfree is auto-corrected. | Additive |

## Verify-the-fix (ran the real tau2 backend on the failing args; venv-tau2-custom)
- T17 baggages: agent args total=3, nonfree=1(WRONG) → override yields nonfree=0, total=3, ZERO stray $50 payment (matches gold nonfree=0). COMMUNICATE was already 1.0 → expect reward 1.0.
- T17 flights: gift_card_8190333 → `payment_change_summary` "A CHARGE of $209…" (correct, unchanged DB).
- T11 flights: GV1N64 downgrade → `payment_change_summary` "A REFUND of $5244 was issued to gift_card_1642017." — contains "5244" (the missing communicate_info). DB already 1.0 → expect reward 1.0 once agent relays it.
- Passing T12 (gold/economy/2pax, total 2): override → nonfree=0 (unchanged) — NO regression.
- Passing T25 book: returns full reservation dict + summary, `reservation_id` present, `Environment.to_json_str` serializes fine — NO regression.

## Process & features used
- Serial (single-session) diagnosis + edits; parsed traces and tau2 gold actions directly, verified via the tau2 venv against the live db.json.
- No prior iterations (seed). RUNMAP empty.

## Good things to PRESERVE
- Baggage override in `update_reservation_baggages` (bounded, corrects nonfree deterministically).
- `payment_change_summary` on money-moving tools + the "report exact amount" policy rule.

## Deliberately skipped
- Task 23 full DB fix (cheapest-business cancel+rebook×3 with split payment) — too complex/high-overfit-risk for one candidate. Only the communicate lever partially helps.
- No `book_reservation` nonfree override (no failing book task needs it; overriding there risks a payment-total mismatch raise) — kept bounded to `update_reservation_baggages`.
